lede: The biggest item this week is Monday's joint HARC and P&Z special session, where the two commissions will work through proposed amendments to Telluride's Land Use Code and Design Guidelines to bring the Town into compliance with the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code — whatever they recommend heads straight to Town Council. The Telluride Hospital District board meets Thursday with mill levy considerations on the agenda, a significant conversation as the hospital pushes toward a new facility. The Open Space Commission also meets Monday with trail and open space project updates, including a NEPA process update for the Perimeter Trail.

notable.stake: Commission recommends wildfire code changes to Town's Land Use Code and Design Guidelines.
Hospital board discusses mill levy — the tax mechanism funding the district and new facility.
NEPA update on Perimeter Trail could shape scope and timeline of a major regional trail project.
